exposure: Hemi-uterus with non-communicating functional rudimentary cavity
cohort: Three adolescent patients diagnosed with Hemi-uterus with non-communicating functional rudimentary cavity.
finding: Microsurgical reconstruction of Hemi-uterus with a non-communicating functional rudimentary cavity resulted in marked improvement in dysmenorrhea, improvement in depressive state, no change in menstrual bleeding volume, and one patient achieved pregnancy with normal prenatal control and cesarean delivery, obtaining a full-term newborn without complications.
mod_finding: One patient who underwent the procedure achieved pregnancy and delivered via cesarean section.
